# Game settings

<!-- Generated by blockloom-core/tests/reference_docs.rs from the type registry. Rerun it with BLESS=1 after a schema change; don't edit by hand. -->

Settings for the whole game, saved in the project index: `set-property target=settings path=...`.

- [Quality](#quality)
- [Input](#input)
- [Sound](#sound)
- [Display](#display)
- [Interface theme](#style)

## quality

Render quality, resolution scaling and the upscaler.

| Field | Type | Default | About |
|---|---|---|---|
| `quality.preset` | one of `Low`, `Medium`, `High`, `Ultra` | `High` |  |
| `quality.resolution_scale` | number | `1.0` |  |
| `quality.dynamic_resolution` | switch | `false` |  |
| `quality.min_scale` | number | `0.5` |  |
| `quality.target_ms` | number | `16.66699981689453` |  |
| `quality.auto_drop` | switch | `false` |  |
| `quality.over_budget_frames` | whole number from 0 | `120` |  |
| `quality.upscaler` | one of `Spatial`, `Taa`, `Dlss` | `Spatial` |  |
| `quality.dlss_mode` | one of `Auto`, `Dlaa`, `Quality`, `Balanced`, `Performance`, `UltraPerformance` | `Auto` |  |
| `quality.sharpness` | number | `0.0` |  |

## sound

One gain per sound bus.

| Field | Type | Default | About |
|---|---|---|---|
| `sound.master_volume` | number | `1.0` |  |
| `sound.music_volume` | number | `1.0` |  |
| `sound.sfx_volume` | number | `1.0` |  |

## display

The output signal, peak brightness and paper white.

| Field | Type | Default | About |
|---|---|---|---|
| `display.space` | one of `Sdr`, `Hdr10`, `Scrgb` | `Sdr` |  |
| `display.peak_nits` | number | `1000.0` | The brightest the display shows, in nits. |
| `display.paper_white_nits` | number | `200.0` | Where 1.0 (paper white, and the HUD) sits under HDR, in nits. |

## style

A `.blockstyle` every interface starts from; a screen's own stylesheets still win.

| Field | Type | Default | About |
|---|---|---|---|
| `style` | any asset |  | **Interface theme** A `.blockstyle` every interface starts from; a screen's own stylesheets still win. |
